en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a horticultural exhibition set up in a city square. Tall clipped trees in tubs and numerous flowering plants are arranged in beds, with people walking and observing the display. Historic multi‑storey buildings with shop signs form the backdrop. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the Grand' Place in Bruges and mentions a horticultural exposition in August 1901. The left margin credits the editor J. Merveille.
